Cross-posting the API question from this MLTP announcement:

The formalization includes proper edge-coloring, Kempe-chain, Kierstead-path, and Δ ≤ 4 Vizing infrastructure for SimpleGraph. Since mathlib4#33313 is developing the core proper-edge-coloring API via line graphs, I would appreciate guidance on whether these reusable layers should target that API directly or be formulated first over EdgeLabeling plus a properness hypothesis.

The source and rebuild instructions are here.
